headline: TSMC to Raise Advanced Chip Packaging Prices by Up to 20%
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company plans to raise advanced chip packaging prices by up to 20% amid soaring artificial intelligence demand.
why: TSMC is the world's dominant contract chipmaker, and its pricing power directly influences gross margins for major global fabless semiconductor designers.

impacts.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited
impacts.why: Price increases of up to 20% on advanced packaging boost foundry profit margins.

why_moved: Overwhelming demand for advanced semiconductor packaging capacity gives TSMC strong pricing leverage to lift service fees without losing customers.
